task: Two facts, then generate a full answer to a location question
model_selection: Validation only; never use reserved test scores to select weights
target: All 576 validation questions correct, then evaluate all 576 reserved test questions and the full finite prompt space. Report every failure.
rtl: Run every held-out query pair in both positions, plus location-swap checks, then compare cached and fresh results; verify all kernels and whole-model references.
scope: Only the fixed grammar and eight objects/eight locations. No claim of open-ended language understanding.
training: Host PyTorch, explicitly separate from RTL inference and prior Snackwell training demonstrations.
